machine_org_code_uq.name: machine_org_code_uq
machine_org_code_uq.where: "machine"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "machine"."code" IS NOT NULL

account_token_target_chk.name: account_token_target_chk
account_token_target_chk.value:
("account_token"."purpose" = 'terminal_pairing' AND "account_token"."terminal_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("account_token"."purpose" <> 'terminal_pairing' AND "account_token"."user_id" IS NOT NULL)

terminal_paired_chk.name: terminal_paired_chk
terminal_paired_chk.value: "terminal"."token_hash" IS NULL OR ("terminal"."paired_at" IS NOT NULL AND "terminal"."expires_at" IS NOT NULL)

gateway_previous_token_chk.name: gateway_previous_token_chk
gateway_previous_token_chk.value: "gateway"."previous_token_hash" IS NULL OR ("gateway"."previous_token_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND "gateway"."previous_token_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)

downtime_reason_system_key_uq.name: downtime_reason_system_key_uq
downtime_reason_system_key_uq.where: "downtime_reason"."system_key" IS NOT NULL AND "downtime_reason"."deleted_at" IS NULL

shift_validity_chk.name: shift_validity_chk
shift_validity_chk.value: "shift"."valid_from" IS NULL OR "shift"."valid_to" IS NULL OR "shift"."valid_from" <= "shift"."valid_to"

tag_sample_value_chk.name: tag_sample_value_chk
tag_sample_value_chk.value: "tag_sample"."value" IS NOT NULL OR "tag_sample"."value_text" IS NOT NULL
